note: Target-independent investigation strategies distilled in docs/investigation-lessons.md. Not behavior evidence for any target; cites no evidence IDs. Target-scoped findings live in docs/target-findings/ and are never placed in packets.

strategies.text: Before attributing a difference to the feature, confirm reset/import/export reproduces the supplied input exactly. A failed or missing confirmation is a collection failure and supports no behavior claim.

Classify each failure separately (procedure/automation, missing evidence or wrong hypothesis, implementation, evaluator, baseline regression) with evidence IDs. Never change behavior to fix a procedure, evaluator or regression failure.

Prefer matched experiments that change one relevant factor (size, position, parameter, contrast direction or distant content) while holding the rest fixed, and state before export what each competing hypothesis predicts.

Compare exact numerical profiles against deterministic calculations for each hypothesis. Measure every instance of a feature, including mirrored or opposite-direction instances, before generalizing from one.

Describe state as usable (all gates pass on the frozen suite), experimental (partial, isolated, not promoted) or verified within a stated scope. A good fit to observations is not a verified mechanism.
Do not propose corrections keyed to particular dimensions, case IDs or fitted constants. Require a general rule stated before coding and checked on development cases that were not used to fit it.
Keep the next action narrow: one failure class, bounded evidence and explicit passing-case constraints to preserve.
Continue from the best hash-verified candidate checkpoint, and compare old and new candidates on the same frozen suite and policy.
If remaining budget or unresolved confounding leaves no supported next action, recommend stopping and report what is unknown instead of widening scope.
